# Average

Gives the mean of the numbers in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Average(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array of numbers. A null element is skipped and not counted; any other element that is not a number is a runtime error. Null is read as an empty array, and a value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The total of the numbers divided by how many there are. The mean is exact when every number is exact and the mean can be held exactly; otherwise it is computed with floating-point values, and a finite mean is still given when the total itself would be too large to hold. Null when the array holds no numbers: when it is empty, null, or holds only null elements.

## Example

`Average([1, 2, null, 6])` returns `3`.

`Average([])` returns null.
